newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific East Asia to restart HK-Manila route.
newsitem.headline: Pacific East Asia to restart HK-Manila route.

text.p: Filipino cargo airline Pacific East Asia Cargo Airlines (PEAC) said it is to resume flights between Hong Kong and Manila.

For the past six months, Federal Express Corporation has leased PEAC's BAe 146 freighter to fly express packages between its Asian hub at Subic Bay in the Philippines and Hong Kong, PEAC managing director Benjamin Solis told Reuters.
Earlier this week, FedEx began its own dedicated Airbus A310 freighter service from Hong Kong to Subic Bay after acquiring traffic rights.
PEAC, which is part owned by rival express operator TNT Asia, said their arrangement with FedEx will end on October 4 and the aircraft will be redeployed back on to the Hong Kong - Manila route.
